articles.title: White House adviser defends President Trump's crypto ties in wake of Clarity Act defeat
articles.snippet: President Donald Trump's crypto adviser, Patrick Witt, accused Democrats of unfairly amplifying Trump's crypto ties as a political weapon.

articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: Inside the chain settling $150 billion of stablecoins a week
articles.snippet: Tron launched as a content-distribution project and has become the settlement layer for a large share of the world's USDT, processing roughly $150 billion to $190 billion of stablecoin transfers a week. Josh Olszewicz of Canary Capital breaks down how the network's economics work and what stablecoin regulation could do to the thesis.

articles.title: MoonPay to acquire SEC-registered North Capital in $60 million all-stock deal
articles.snippet: The acquisition will support MoonPay’s aim of supporting mass adoption of tokenized real-world assets, CEO Ivan Soto-Wright said.

articles.title: FTX, Alameda-linked wallets send $75 million in ether to Wintermute, onchain data shows
articles.snippet: Onchain analysts PeckShield and EmberCN say the funds moved to a Wintermute wallet, but neither a sale nor the purpose of the transfer have been confirmed.

articles.title: BlackRock says AI agents could drive stablecoin and crypto adoption
articles.snippet: The asset manager sees payments as the nearer-term opportunity, while markets for computing capacity remain at an early stage
